purpose: Independent POS and NEG physical disk-radius and physical propagation-gate ablation

prompt.per_slice: erode 2px -> 8-connected components -> top 3 -> area >=50mm2 using true XY spacing -> dilate 2px
prompt.center: argmax physical XY Euclidean distance transform in each postprocessed component
prompt.disk: physical XY disk; only image-FOV clipping, never error/component/GT/nnUNet/body clipping

training.training_propagation: random single direction per patient update (forward or backward, approximately 50/50)

selection.order: best checkpoint epoch -> best gate per training radius -> best training radius
selection.checkpoint: fixed 11-case validation correction Dice only; no gate sweep by epoch
selection.gate: Dice >= Dmax-0.001, then lowest mean HD95, then smaller m
selection.radius: Dice >= Dmax-0.001, then lowest mean HD95, then smaller r
selection.pos_neg: fully independent; no combined branch analysis in this stage
selection.test_protocol: After validation locks m*(r) for every r and r*, test every prelocked (r,m*(r)) for the sensitivity curve; test never changes r*. Save NIfTI only for each r's prelocked m*(r).
